about_the_game:
For those who want classical tower defense experience Tower Petroleum gives towers, tower upgrades, monsters, economical upgrades and strategic experience like you had before!

Tower Petroleum has a narrative element to it. Every choice you make, shaped by your own moral compass, forges a unique path, not only influencing the story but also defining your entire gameplay experience.

Features:

  • Unique levels with different strategic possibilities.

  • Deck-building team assembling mechanic

  • Different branches of towers upgrades: feed your enemies lead or disintegrate them with deadly plasma, use drones or fire: whatever fits your playstyle.

  • 18 unique monsters: deadly sharktopuses, hideous roll-eyed-grapplers, dark-matter crawlers. Look in the eyes of abyss and try to stay sane.

  • A deep story with moral choices. Who will you become: a cold-blooded monster who does what it takes to try to save what left of human race or will you try to find compassion and kindness in those shivering deserts. Your choices will give you unique traits that will define your playstyle.

  • 3 different endings depending on your playstyle.

name: Tower Petroleum
short_description: Get ready to face tough choices while struggling to survive the Apocalypse! Tower Petroleum blends classic tower defense with a gripping story. Defend against deep-dwelling monsters, but beware — survival might turn you into one!
